title: macOS 26: 4.7.1 Metal deadlocks in MTLCompilerService on CanvasShaderRD pipeline compile; 4.6.3 does not (M4 + M5)
body:
### Tested versions

- **Reproduces:** Godot **4.7.1.stable.mono.official** (`a13da4feb`) — native Metal *and* `--rendering-driver vulkan` (MoltenVK 1.4.1)
- **Does not reproduce:** Godot **4.6.3.stable.mono.official** (`7d41c59c4`) — native Metal 4.0 Forward+, same machines, same OS
- **Does not reproduce:** 4.7.1 `--rendering-method gl_compatibility --rendering-driver opengl3` (boots; not RenderingDevice)

### System information

Two machines, **same OS build**:

- macOS **26.6.2 (25G83)** — MacBook Pro, Apple **M5** (AGXMetal**G17G**, Apple9)
- macOS **26.6.2 (25G83)** — Mac mini, Apple **M4** (AGXMetal**G16G_B0**, Apple9)

Godot log line on hang: `Metal 4.0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M4 (Apple9)` (M5 equivalent on the laptop).

### Issue description

4.7.1 **permanently deadlocks** during startup shader/pipeline compile. Not slow — CPU drops to ~0%, no window, Force Quit required. `sample` shows the main thread in `std::condition_variable::wait` while `com.apple.MTLCompilerConnectionQueue` is stuck in:

`-[AGXGxxFamilyDevice newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:…]` → `createFragmentProgramVariant` → `compileFunction_Impl` → `MTLCompilerScheduler::buildRequest`

G17G on M5, G16G_B0 on M4. Same shape. Vulkan/MoltenVK hits the **same** `MTLCompilerConnectionQueue` (MoltenVK still compiles Metal).

**4.6.3 on the same two Macs does not hang.** Empty Forward+ project, `load()` of our canvas shaders, and a 4.7-feature-stripped copy of the game all stay at ~13% CPU; cache misses compile.

**4.7.1 is not “all Metal is dead”:**

| What | 4.7.1 Metal | 4.6.3 Metal |
|--|--|--|
| Empty project (one `ColorRect`, Forward+) | **Boots** (~13% CPU, `main.tscn` loaded, CanvasShaderRD cache misses compile) | Boots |
| `load()` of our `led_lattice_v4_*.gdshader` files, no draw | **Boots** (`PRELOAD_DONE`) | Boots |
| Full project (2D canvas LED lattice + RD compute GLSL, many CanvasShaderRD variants) | **Deadlock** after `Shader cache miss for CanvasShaderRD/…` while loading lattice/compute shaders | Does not deadlock (4.6 cannot *run* this 4.7 project; it *does* compile the same shader family) |

Hang is **pipeline compile of specific CanvasShaderRD variants**, not editor boot and not `load()` of the `.gdshader` text. Last 4.7.1 lines before freeze include several `Shader cache miss for CanvasShaderRD/1ac5f6c8d534ebab572b3f886e38134784245fbd5fa01c7cbb6cc452e5400080/<variant>` then compute GLSL imports; then silence.

Hang is **Metal, not C#**. Samples have **no** .NET frames on the stuck thread. Reproduces with the official Mono binary because pipeline compile is in the engine.

4.7 rewrote the macOS Metal driver in C++; hang stacks mention `MTL4CompilerTask`.

**Related, already checked, not the same:**

- #106757 — first load *slow* (`MTLCompilerService` busy). Ours never returns; CPU ~0%; Force Quit.
- #119436 — runtime `wait: timeout waiting for fence`. Ours is startup CanvasShaderRD pipeline compile.
- #120566 — 4.7 Metal 2D misrender/crash; Vulkan is a workaround. Ours hangs on **Vulkan too**.

### Steps to reproduce

1. macOS 26.6.x, Apple Silicon, Godot **4.7.1** (Mono or standard — hang is Metal, not C#).
2. Open/run a Forward+ project that actually **draws** several custom canvas shaders (not just `load()`s them). Our case: LED-lattice canvas shaders + RD compute `.glsl`.
3. Vanilla `--path .` is enough; no save needed. Splash appears, then freeze (~15s, “Not Responding”, CPU ~0%).
4. `sample <pid> 5 -file hang.txt` and grep `AGXMetal|MTLCompiler|newRenderPipeline`.

Contrast: same machine, **4.6.3**, empty Forward+ project or `load()` of those shaders → boots.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

A one-`ColorRect` project **does not** reproduce on 4.7.1. `load()` of the lattice `.gdshader` files **does not** reproduce. The hang is when 4.7.1 *compiles pipelines* for those shaders as used by the full project.

I can share a stripped MRP if useful. Three `sample` dumps from 4.7.1 are attached as a gist (M5 Metal, M4 Metal, M4 Vulkan). Happy to try a Godot-provided canvas-shader MRP.

### Sample excerpts

M5 / 4.7.1 native Metal (`AGXMetalG17G`):

```
-[AGXG17GFamilyDevice newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:options:reflection:error:]  (in AGXMetalG17G)
  createFragmentProgramVariant …
    compileFunction_Impl …
      -[MTLCompiler compileFunctionRequestInternal:…]  (in Metal)
        MTLCompilerScheduler::buildRequest …
Thread: com.apple.MTLCompilerConnectionQueue
Main thread: std::condition_variable::wait
```

M4 / 4.7.1 native Metal: identical, `AGXG16GFamilyDevice` / `AGXMetalG16G_B0`.

M4 / 4.7.1 Vulkan: still `com.apple.MTLCompilerConnectionQueue` + `AGXMetalG16G_B0`.

Full `sample` dumps (macOS `sample` of the hung 4.7.1 process):

- https://github.com/Ikadzuchi77/godot-47-metal-hang-samples (M5 Metal, M4 Metal, M4 Vulkan)
